purpose: Macaulay and modified duration for a standard even-period bullet bond, given face value, coupon rate, yield to maturity, years to maturity, and compounding frequency. Prices the schedule and reports the PV-weighted average time to cash flows in years. Feeds compute_dv01 and compute_convexity for full fixed-income risk analytics.
